desc: Creative coffee drinks & international fast food dished up in a colourful, light-filled space.
addr: 2, Sector 4, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: This is the cutest cafe I found near Hsr Layout. The ambience and seating area was classy each corner looks so attractive. We started with Affogato and it the best start as per this place. After that we match also and that is also perfect …

Food was pretty average. The second pic I have uploaded is Strawberry French Toast. I can make better french toast at home. Disappointed primarily due to that one dish. The sides are pretty dry and the insides as well. Hope it's visible …

Banoffee Cafe is a great spot if you’re looking for an all-day breakfast place. Their sourdough sandwiches are absolutely delicious—I especially loved the Peri Peri Chicken Sandwich, which was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly made. …
